text: dsh-vision-no-vision 是面向 DSH 的图像理解工具插件：它注册 vision-nv 工具，把指定图片转换为元数据、灰度字符图、边缘图和粗略颜色网格，再调用会话当前或显式配置的文本模型生成图像分析。支持常见图片解码与模型输出上限、超时设置，适合在纯文本模型环境中查看图片内容；需要 DSH 0.2.x 兼容运行时及可用的模型路由。

dsh-vision-no-vision adds the vision-nv tool to DSH. It converts an image into metadata, grayscale and edge grids, and coarse colors, then asks the active or configured text model to interpret them. It requires a DSH 0.2.x runtime and a model route.

dsh-vision-no-vision 的功能「图片文字化」：vision-nv 会读取图片并生成元数据、灰度字符图、边缘图和粗略颜色网格；这些表示作为一次性输入交给文本模型分析。
dsh-vision-no-vision 的功能「模型路由」：调用 vision-nv 时可指定 provider 与 model；也可使用当前会话活动路由。插件向 DSH LLM 服务发送一次请求，并将生成的文本作为工具结果返回。
dsh-vision-no-vision 的功能「图片格式解码」：图像转换器可处理 BMP、GIF、PNG，并通过 sharp 处理其他常见格式；GIF 解码选择第一帧，输出规范化 RGB 后构建文本视图。
dsh-vision-no-vision 的功能「独立转换命令行」：独立 CLI 接收一个图片路径，将转换出的元数据与字符视图打印到标准输出；参数错误、文件不存在或处理失败时返回错误信息。

dsh-vision-no-vision README · dsh-vision-no-vision：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(dsh) plugin that gives a **text-only** LLM vision capability!!!

dsh-vision-no-vision README · Compatibility：This release targets the DSH **0.2.x** plugin API, and is built and tested
against `dsh 0.2.1-rc.1` (Cordis 4.0.5). The manifest declares
`engines.dsh: >=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0`, so the launcher refuses to load it on an
incompatible runtime instead of failing at call time.

Peer packages: `@deepseek-ai/cordis` ^4.0.5,
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` ^0.2.1-rc.1, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` ^0.2.1-rc.1.

dsh-vision-no-vision README · Install：```
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-vision-no-vision
```

dsh-vision-no-vision README · Configuration：```yaml
- name: dsh-vision-no-vision
  config:
    # Cap for one complete analysis (conversion + model call), in ms.
    timeoutMs: 3600000

Without `provider`/`model`, the tool reads the route from the calling
session's latest request header, so the image is analyzed by the same model
that is driving the conversation.
dsh-vision-no-vision README · Note：Seriously, it is not a serious plugin 😝. The tool generates an ascii-art from the input image and feed it into the text-only LLM to guess the content.

dsh-vision-no-vision README · Development：```
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build
```

The keyless smoke test runs the real tool pipeline and LLM runtime against a
mock adapter:

```
cd smoke
node --import tsx <deepseek-harness-checkout>/vendor/cordis/bin.js
```
